events.text: For years now the Upper Realm has had nothing new to tell you. The isles drift the same circles. The Jade Court argues the same arguments. A gate stands at the end of the cloud road where no gate was before: plain wood, unpainted, half open. Beyond it, a light with no colour. A voice that sounds like your own says: the heavens can no longer hold you.

choices.text: Not yet. Stay among the clouds a while

effects.log: You turn back down the jade road. The gate does not close. It will wait. Gates like that have nothing but time.

choices.text: Ask the gate what lies beyond

effects.log: You ask. The gate answers with silence so complete that, for an hour, you understand everything you have ever been taught. Then it is gone, and so is the gate, for now.

You do not look back, because there is nothing behind you that is not already carried. The gate is warm under your hand. On the other side the light is not light, and you are not anyone, and that is not frightening at all. Below the clouds, in every temple that still keeps your name, the incense burns straight up for a whole day.

variants: The Upper Realm has had nothing new to tell you for years: the same drifting circles, the same arguments at the Jade Court. At the end of the cloud road stands a plain wooden gate, half open, light with no colour behind it. A voice like your own says the heavens can no longer hold you.

The gate is still there at the end of the cloud road, plain wood, half open, the colourless light waiting behind it. Nothing up here has surprised you in a long time. Your own voice, from beyond: the heavens cannot hold you.
